!
version 17.9
service password-encryption
hostname CORE-SW-01
!
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abcdefghijklmn$ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789abcdefg
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 9 $9$zyxwvutsrqponm$ZYXWVUTSRQPONMLKJIHGFEDCBA9876543210zyxwvut
!
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group tacacs+
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group tacacs+
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip ssh version 2
login block-for 120 attempts 5 within 60
!
snmp-server group SNMPv3GRP v3 priv
!
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 0822455D0A16 7
ntp authenticate
ntp trusted-key 1
ntp server 10.0.0.1 key 1
!
logging host 10.0.0.50
logging trap informational
!
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACL
 permit 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255
!
control-plane
 service-policy input COPP-POLICY
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description Uplink to Core
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description UNUSED
 switchport access vlan 999
 shutdown
!
banner motd ^CAuthorized Access Only^C
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-ACL in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 access-class MGMT-ACL in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 transport input ssh
!
end
